options.name: Chaotic Good Outsider (Azata)
options.benefit: Configure a chaotic good outsider companion. Choose its biped, quadruped, or serpentine base form.
companionRules: Alignment and subtype: chaotic good outsider (azata).
Use unchained eidolon base statistics at full Druid level.
Evolution pool is always 0; only base-form and subtype evolutions apply.
